result:
The verdict is written to `JUDGE/verdict.json`. The change does most of what F2 asks, but one part of the Decided paragraph isn't built.

What I ran: typecheck, the golden tests, and the commands, maneuvers, sweep, docTables and pacingBuilt unit tests. All pass. I didn't run the e2e or the gallery.

**Findings:**
- **Major:** when the same captain has another turn waiting, the pass doesn't carry on to it. In pass mode `Sortie` drops the P4 wait that `nearWaits` injects (`movers.ts:258`) and always flies to its rest (`movers.ts:324`). The next turn can't start until 1915 ms, so the ship lands at its rest and then flies out again. That's the "fly home between turns" that P4 exists to prevent. The docs (05 P-7, 15 §10) were changed to describe this ("ignores the wait"), not fixed in the code.
- **Minor:** when the summoner has no ship here and flies as a guest, the call blip is drawn at the station's centre, not at the summoner (`stationJumpIn.ts:46-48`). So for a guest the blip and the arrival no longer read as one cause and effect (R8, R10).
- **Minor (rules):** on the directed measure, Meteor, the pod with 36 summons, gets longer: −7.8 s in F2's row, and App s goes from 275.9 to 296.1 s. A hand-written note gives the undirected savings. A test checks only Meteor's (> 10 s); the Quasar and Pulsar figures are untested prose.
- **Minor (rules):** 15 §10 and 05 K-4 say the plate stays whole "on a moving ship". In the code the ship stops at its rest 0.8 s after the blip, so the whole plate rides a moving ship for only about 0.28 s of its 1.8 s.
- **Nit:** 13 §6 calls the blip a ring "at twice the ship's radius". The code draws a ring growing from 1.4× to 3.2× the ship's radius. The test checking that shape tolerates ±0.5.

**Acceptance:**

| # | Line | Verdict | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Gallery cell, full and reduced motion | partial | An existing e2e covers the cell, but I couldn't run it and there's no evidence it was run |
| 2 | Unit test: no hold, act within 50 ms of the blip | met | Tests (d) and (e) cover both, in full and reduced motion |
| 3 | 15 §7 row, docTables, goldens | met | Row is 1915 and docTables passes; `director.json` is the only golden that moved, and no other golden involves the jump-in. I couldn't check that the packet names each change, because the process records were removed |
| 4 | Ledger shows the saving per pod | partial | All seven pods have rows, but Meteor reads negative on the directed measure |
